description: Smoke test of the campus-customs-ops MCP server, called from Claude Code (vibe coder) over its stdio MCP connection. Each output was cross-checked against data/campus_customs_new.db with direct SQL.
connection_config: .mcp.json (project root); also registered in ~/.claude.json so the Claude desktop app loads it

tests.prompt: Ticket 101: Tauhid Zaman wants one Classic Bulldog Tee (CC-TEE-WHITE) in size S. Is it on the shelf, and where?

db_check.sql: SELECT sku, name, size, qty, location FROM inventory WHERE sku='CC-TEE-WHITE' AND size='S'

tests.prompt: Ticket 102: an email from Elm City Properties says shop rent is due in 2 days. What does lease 1 actually say, how much cash do we have, and how many days until rent is due from the desk date?

sql: SELECT id, space_name, landlord, monthly_rent, next_due, notes FROM leases WHERE id=1
SELECT name, balance, date FROM cash_accounts
db_check.derived: days_until_due = 2026-09-02 minus desk date 2026-08-31 = 2, which matches the email's 'due in 2 days'

tests.prompt: Ticket 103: Yale AI Club wants 20 Basic Hoodie Big Yale (CC-HOOD-NAVY) at a bulk discount. What does each hoodie cost us, what is the list price, and what margin do we have to work with?

db_check.sql: SELECT sku, unit_cost, list_price FROM pricing WHERE sku='CC-HOOD-NAVY'

summary: 3 of 3 tools returned values identical to data/campus_customs_new.db. All tools are read-only, and the working copy is still byte-identical to the original after the tests.
